description: Find the least positive integer with the requested number of distinct unordered representations as a sum of two positive integer cubes.

source.title: New Upper Bounds for Taxicab and Cabtaxi Numbers

output.encoding: least n with at least k distinct unordered pairs 1<=a<=b and a^3+b^3=n

contract.definition: Taxicab(k) is the least positive integer expressible in k distinct ways as a sum of two positive integer cubes; only k=2 and k=3 are accepted
contract.pair_order: Representations are unordered and normalized as 1<=a<=b; a=b is allowed but contributes one pair
contract.primary_method: Initialize one increasing row per a, with b from a through 444; repeatedly remove the global minimum pair-sum, group all equal sums, advance each removed row by one b, and return the first group with multiplicity at least k
contract.independent_method: Materialize every pair sum for 1<=a<=b<=444, sort all sums, and scan equal-value runs for the first multiplicity at least k
contract.root_bound: The largest requested least value is Taxicab(3)=87539319. Since 445^3=88121125 is greater than that value, each positive cube root in any representation at or below it is at most 444
contract.invalid_cases: Null input, empty or non-exact frame, trailing word, or k outside {2,3} returns -1
contract.distinction: The profile enumerates sums of positive cubes with distinct unordered representations; it does not enumerate signed-cube Cabtaxi values or merely test a supplied integer

complexity.primary_time: At most 98,790 heap removals and row advances, O(P log 444) time for P unordered pairs
complexity.primary_space: 444 heap nodes, each three signed 32-bit fields (5,328 bytes), plus scalar state
complexity.independent_time: O(P log P) sorting over all P=98,790 pair sums
complexity.independent_space: O(P) Python integers; their packed signed-64 payload would be 790,320 bytes, before Python list and integer-object overhead
